captions.say: Windows says nine hundred thirty-one gigabytes. Nothing's missing.

captions.text: Drive makers count in powers of *ten:*

captions.say: its gigabyte is one billion, seventy-three million, seven hundred forty-one thousand, eight hundred twenty-four bytes.

captions.text: Divide a trillion by that, and you get !931.!
captions.say: Divide a trillion by that, and you get nine hundred thirty-one.

captions.text: The binary unit even has its own name,
the *gibibyte,* but almost nobody uses it.
captions.say: the gibby-byte, but almost nobody uses it.
So a two-terabyte drive shows one thousand, eight hundred sixty-two.
